🚀 Iran downs another $35,000 US LUCAS drone over Hormuz Iran’s Army Air Defense Force shot down a US LUCAS one-way attack drone over the Persian Gulf, east of the Strait of Hormuz , the Army’s public relations office said. The drone was destroyed by domestically developed Iranian air defense systems operating under the country’s integrated air defense network. LUCAS is modeled on Iran’s Shahed-136 , and each US drone reportedly costs around $35,000 . It is far from the first LUCAS Iran has brought down, with previous US drones of the same type intercepted over southern Iran and near the Strait of Hormuz . 👍 Substack | Chat | @geopolitics_prime
